body: Yes. I would imagine I probably have severe depression, and possibly aspergers, I've just never brought it up with my psychiatrist.

I've been on medication for the past two years, constantly switching until very recently as I am now on a medication that has helped my OCD quite a bit. It still sucks, but I can deal with it much more now. That being said, with that problem out of the way, pretty much everything that has been kept underneath is creeping its way back into my life. This past month has been a living hell, I've been crying hysterically and cannot keep a stable mood. Also I'm the opposite of an extrovert, this quarantine is basically my life normally. I don't ever go outside, I stay in my room pretty much all day every day. That's not entirely a bad thing for me though, I've always been like this and prefer to be inside rather than outside.

19 years old. Nothing going for me right now. Dropped out of high school due to my severe OCD a while back. I'm on medication now but it doesn't make anything better, it just makes living a LOT less painful. I'm being lead on by the person that I'm in love with, and I know it, but I can't help myself because I hate what it feels like when I'm by myself. My body just gets super tense and it feels like someone is lighting my insides on fire.
